name: qr-cow-mcp
description: Create, style, and manage QR codes (with scan analytics) from any MCP client.
long_description: MCP server for qr-cow.com. Tools: create static or dynamic QR codes in 13 content types (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, event, crypto, and more), render styled codes with colors, gradients, and logos, list and inspect saved codes, update a dynamic code's destination after printing, and pull privacy-first scan analytics. Static generation works without an account; management tools use a qr-cow personal access token.

api_token.title: qr-cow API token
api_token.description: Personal access token from your qr-cow dashboard (Settings > API). Optional: only needed for saving codes, dynamic destinations, and analytics.

tools.name: create_qrcode
tools.description: Create a static or dynamic QR code (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, and more)

tools.name: render_styled_qrcode
tools.description: Render a styled QR image with colors, gradients, and a logo

tools.name: update_qrcode_destination
tools.description: Change where a dynamic QR code redirects

tools.name: get_qrcode_analytics
tools.description: Scan analytics for a QR code
